uncertain.note: The accent mark over υ is broken. It reads as a circumflex plus a breathing; I took the breathing to be rough (οὗ), but smooth (οὖ) cannot be ruled out.
The breathing on υ looks smooth (αὐτοῦ), not rough (αὑτοῦ, which the earlier OCR had). The reflexive αὑτοῦ might be what was meant.
The punctuation after τινι sits right at the edge of the scan and is partly cut off. I read it as a colon.
